maya: Quick PM — postmortem follow-up for last night's GPU surge. TL;DR: autoscaler lag + quota ceiling caused model fallbacks for a set of heavy routes. Want owners/timelines for remediation items.
kevin: I'll take scheduler tuning. Plan: tune token bucket and eviction thresholds, add integration test. Propose changes: `autoscaler.burst_window = 30s`, `grace_period = 60s`. Target canary deploy Wed 2026-04-01. :thumbsup:
sophia: I'll own the quota request with cloud infra. Need peak qps and expected GPU hours. Can someone paste the 1hr peak numbers?
maya: 1hr peak = 9.8K tokens/s, ~72 GPU-min in us-west-2 per minute peak — likely need +40% quota. I'll drop metrics into the ticket.
olivia: I'll take headroom plan + runbook. Proposal: baseline 20% spare capacity per region, automated daily headroom audit, monthly load drill. I'll add a runbook stub to docs and run a dry drill next week.
zane: I'll coordinate customer comms and prioritize enterprise customers affected; will sync with CS.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-2410001234 logged. Action items created: #A scheduler-tune -> kevin, #B quota-request -> sophia, #C headroom-plan -> olivia. https://redwood.internal/inc/2410001234
kevin: quick config snippet I'll test:
```
# autoscaler config
max_replicas: 400
burst_window: 30s
eviction_threshold: 0.8
```
I'll push a feature branch and tag @olivia for runbook updates.
sophia: Filed quota ticket to cloud-team: https://redwood.internal/tickets/7890 — asking for +50 GPUs in us-west-2 as emergent bump. cc @finance. ETA reply 48h.
maya: Great. Can we put concrete delivery dates in this thread? kevin? olivia?
kevin: Scheduler proposals PR by 2410060000, canary rollout 2410100000. (will add to PR description)
olivia: Runbook draft by 2410050000, headroom audit automation PR by 2410120000.
zane: I'll track these on the remediation board and set weekly sync Fridays 09:30 PT until closure. :calendar:
maya: Thanks — please add short one-line acceptance criteria to each item (what "done" looks like). I'll consolidate into the postmortem follow-ups doc.
kevin: Done — acceptance: autoscaler maintains <200ms scale latency for target spikes in lab test and passes integration tests.
sophia: Acceptance: cloud quota increased or documented fallback plan + approval from finance.
olivia: Acceptance: runbook has step-by-step drill + automated alert if headroom <15%.
maya: tagging owners: @kevin, @sophia, @olivia, @zane. Will follow up Mon. :eyes:
kevin: :thumbsup:
olivia: :thumbsup:
